name: battery rundown: VLC plays Big Buck Bunny 1080p 60 fps on repeat from 100 % to the automatic shutdown (90 Hz, backlight 128 of 255, airplane mode, volume 3 of 15); the operator unplugs USB when told, and after the shutdown plugs it back in and powers the device on; no EL2 monitor (it costs power); stock and the hypervisor image on the same device, two runs each

phases.note: apk: key in third_party/apks.lock (STAB_APK_DIR), media: key in third_party/media.lock (STAB_MEDIA_DIR); the player needs its one-time preparation per install (README)
